blocks.text: Files can be transferred securely through the Private Access (ZPA) cloud via a designated privileged console from a Privileged Remote Access (PRA) portal. These files can then be downloaded or uploaded with the option to inspect the files using Internet & SaaS (ZIA) Sandbox File Transfer.
Configuring the integrations for the Internet & SaaS Sandbox File Transfer provides the following benefit and enables you to:

blocks.item: Inspect files you are uploading in a privileged console for malware or malicious content.
Safeguard the privileged console by inspecting larger files.

blocks.text: To enable the Inspect option for the File Transfer feature for privileged consoles, you first need to set up the parameters for the Internet & SaaS Sandbox integration. If you do not set up the integration configurations, then the Inspect option is automatically disabled.
After you have configured the Internet & SaaS Sandbox integration, set up the consoles policy for the privileged consoles.
To learn more about PRA, see Understanding Privileged Remote Access. To set up PRA, see Step-by-Step Configuration Guide for Privileged Remote Access.
The Sandbox Integration page is read-only for Microtenant admins.
On the Sandbox Integration page (Zero Trust Browser > Privileged Remote Access > Sandbox Integration), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View the current Sandbox Integration settings.

blocks.text: To configure Sandbox Integration settings (Zero Trust Browser > Privileged Remote Access > Sandbox Integration):

blocks.item: ZIA Cloud: Enter the name of the Internet & SaaS Cloud with the Sandbox you are accessing.
Cloud Service API Key: Enter the API key for the Internet & SaaS Cloud.
ZIA Admin Username: Enter the username for that specific Internet & SaaS Admin account.
ZIA Admin Password: Enter the password for that specific Internet & SaaS Admin account.
Sandbox API Token: Enter the API key for the Internet & SaaS Sandbox.

blocks.text: If you don’t include the username, password, or token, you cannot continue. All fields must be completed before you can move forward.
